program: dup [ 1 1 add div ] map 0 [ dup add add ] fold [ sub 1 add ] fold
notes: Intermediates: the halves x//2, twice their sum, then a fold over the values subtracting each and adding one, since x - 2*(x//2) is 1 for odd and 0 for even. Floor division makes it exact for negatives.

program: over over sub [ add ] dip [ [ lt? ] swap cons ] dip [ filter ] dip [ swap lt? ] swap cons filter 0 [ drop 1 add ] fold
notes: Compute the open interval (t-r, t+r), keep values below t+r, keep those above t-r, count. Bounds are built and bound under dip so no glue run exceeds 8.

program: [ 0 swap sub ] map [ [ cons ] swap cons ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map dup [ uncons swap drop ] map nil [ cons ] fold [ [ lt? ] swap cons ] map [ [ cons ] swap cons ] map nil [ map nil cons ] fold [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold [ uncons quote cons ] map [ uncons [ filter ] fold ] map nil [ cat ] fold 0 [ sub ] fold
notes: Negate, build per element the list of 'strictly below earlier value' filters of its prefix (prefix idiom: fold map-then-cons over prepend closures), zip each value in with a queue fold, run the prefix filters on the value's singleton, sum survivors and negate back. Quadratic in length, general.

program: nil cons [ quote ] map [ [ cons ] cat ] map [ [ swap cons ] cat ] map uncons [ nil eq? ] filter [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold [ [ quote ] swap cons ] map [ [ cat cat ] cat ] map uncons uncons swap drop [ quote ] map [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold nil [ cons ] fold
notes: Split into the two slots with a two-list alternating fold (closures x cons swap cons; the prepended nil becomes the (nil) seed), zip the slots back as (x y) pairs with a queue fold, which comes out reversed, then reverse. 72 ops against the fused 69.

program: [ [ sub ] swap cons ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map dup [ uncons swap drop ] map [ uncons drop ] dip [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold uncons drop [ quote ] map [ [ mul ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map dup [ uncons swap drop quote ] map [ [ 0 lt? ] filter ] map [ 0 [ add ] fold ] map [ uncons drop ] dip [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold uncons drop [ 0 lt? ] filter 0 [ drop 1 add ] fold
notes: Adjacent differences x_i - x_(i+1) by a queue fold (pop head, run closure x sub quote cat), clamp to min(e,0) via singleton filter and sum, multiply each clamped difference by the next difference with a second queue fold (negative exactly at a rise then fall), count negatives.
